job: Enter a free-form list of values, one token each.
purpose: A field that turns typed values into removable tokens. Enter or a comma adds one, Backspace on an empty field removes the last, and pasted lists split on commas and new lines. Without script it is a text area with one value per line; with it, one hidden input posts the same lines, or a JSON array with data-format="json". data-pattern flags bad values, data-max caps the count.
useWhen: The list is free text: domains, IP ranges, emails, keywords, redirect URIs.
The server stores a list, and nobody should type JSON.

avoidWhen.when: The values come from a fixed list.
Each entry has a name and a value.

states.name: invalid value
states.how: a token with data-invalid; data-pattern sets the rule

states.name: full
states.how: data-max stops adding past a count

states.name: new token
states.how: data-new on a token as it is added

parts.role: The remove button on a token.

keyboard.does: Adds the typed value as a token.
On an empty field: removes the last token.
